messages:
maya: Heads up — I'm sketching a short playbook for panel sharding + prefetch to tame dashboard tail latency. Would like quick sync and owners.

sam: 👍 can you drop the numbers you saw? rough is fine.

maya: p50 ~80ms, p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.2s on heavy tenant with 12 widgets. problem appears when frontend fanout triggers synchronous fetches across 8+ backends.

jena: is this the same regression after the projection change? we saw extra joins in the query path.

maya: related but separate. projection added CPU pressure; this is more about high fanout + auth checks causing head-of-line blocking. RBAC checks are currently inline in the query executor.

liam: quick tradeoff thought: move RBAC to a fast prefilter (authz cache) so remote calls avoid per-row policy eval. downside: slightly looser freshness for permission changes.

kai: we could shard panels by tenant modulo N (eg `shard_key = tenant_id % 16`) and colocate frequently-used widgets in the same shard to improve locality. That reduces cross-shard scatter.

maya: proposal draft: 1) panel-level sharding (tenant-aware) 2) asynchronous prefetch of non-critical widgets with local LRU cache 3) authz prefilter cache with 30s TTL + invalidation hook for role changes 4) SLO: p95 <= 300ms for interactive dashboards, fallback lane for >300ms.

sam: curious about the async prefetch UX — if non-critical widgets load later, do we show placeholders? what about critical KPIs?

maya: critical KPIs are in sync path (pin to fast lane). non-critical (historic charts, heavy aggregations) go to prefetch lane with optimistic rendering.

jena: perf question: how do we avoid thundering herd when prefetch warms caches after deploy or ramp?

liam: suggested mitigations: jittered prefetch with backoff, bloom filter to avoid cold fetching for known-empty panels, and small warmup windows per shard.

kai: also worth measuring cost impact — micro-sharding increases routing complexity but can reduce avg CPU by co-locating hot panels. we need a cost model: tokens/requests -> CPU/latency delta.

maya: agreed. I'll prototype metrics: per-shard p50/p95/p99, cache hit rate, authz-cache hit rate, and prefetch-induced extra QPS.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline check: `ci/build/console-shard-proto` passed on staging at 2026-03-18T09:12Z :white_check_mark:

sam: operationally, what's the rollback story if sharding causes regressions? feature flag per-tenant + rollout by % then instant switch to monolith path.

maya: exactly — canary via feature-flag, fallback to sync path if p95 increases >10% vs baseline.

jena: one more RBAC edge: some tenants have very dynamic role changes. For them we should allow TTL=0 mode (always authoritative) behind a tenant toggle.

liam: owner suggestions: maya prototyping (prefetch + metrics), kai routing/shard mapping, jena authz cache/invalidation, sam ops cutover plan. I'll help with cost model.

maya: thanks — I'll open a short RFC and link a prototype PR. For now TL;DR: shard by tenant, async-prefetch non-critical widgets, move RBAC to prefilter cache (with per-tenant authoritative toggle), feature-flag rollout and SLO-based fallback.

sam: :thumbsup: please drop RFC link here when ready.

maya: will do. cc @jena @kai @liam

ops-bot: Reminder: staging loadtest scheduled for 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC.

jena: noted. I'll prepare authz invalidation tests.

maya: last: we should decide on shard count as config (default 16) and allow per-cluster override. putting that in the RFC.

liam: fine to start 16, metric-based autoscale later.

maya: thanks all — meeting if needed after RFC comments.
